candidates.title: Path Of Wuxia review
candidates.text: It isn't a bad game, first off the graphics are not going to blow your mind. The art style however is very much left me satisfied. This is a SRPG with turn based combat and none of the complexity more modern SRPGs use to make things more active. With that said the games focus oddly doesn't seem to be the combat but rather the story being told and interactions with other students, and in that way the game is less so an SRPG and more so a Novel. This is an example of a still young genre that I think is inaccurately categorized as Martial Arts, this should instead be the Genre "Wuxia" in as much as we use "Fantasy" in the West and know what that's about. So on the game itself; If you are looking for a story about school life but with some wuxia elements thrown in - this is the game for you. I have to say that it is honestly close to me saying it's a kind of dating simulation but again Romance is part of Wuxia. There is a Discord community for the English translation which does a cracking job at it, but because of this I can't exactly say if the game does a good job of getting you interested in the drama of these npcs but the content here is certainly not lacking. There is an unfortunate grind to the game and a time table it forces on to you, there are no classic wuxia hidden benefits found in places that allow the MC a unique body tempering technique or heavenly scrolls of the gods gate qi manipulations. Instead you grind it out seemingly like everyone else. But you are special because you can change your element mid fight. This is pretty cool but a signal of the games only failure - the lack of content about the player themself. In Wuxia stories what engages people isn't the love interest or the friends but rather the Main Character and so far there is a problem here.Music is great, controls are good, it support controller as well though barely.

candidates.title: Modules
candidates.text:
See also: Module Summary

Modules, also known as Modular Systems, Modifications, or Mods, are systems, such as weapons, armor, or aircraft hangars, that a player can use to improve and/or customize a super captial ship (Battlecruiser or Carrier). In game, they are simply known as systems, but the term module has come into wide use to differentiate them from the fixed/non-modular systems that are more common.

Modules, in-game, are labelled with a letter and number. No two modules with the same letter (for example, M1 and M2) may be active at the same time, and so each letter group has been unofficially labelled a slot. All of the super capital ships have at least three and as many as seven slots, M for the main weapon/system, A, B, C, D, E, and F. By default, the only available and installed modules are M1 and A1. Getting additional M and A modules gives the player the option of changing out one of the default systems, but getting B, C, or D modules allows them to add new capabilities to their ship. Note that the slots are different for the FSV830 - Fast Combat Support Ship, which has no extra modules for the main weapon, so there is no M slot, but still has five swappable slots - A, B, C, D, and E, with the B and D slots being unlocked by default with the B1 and D1 modules.

Players can aquire mods when they draw a super capital ship blueprint they already have. In this case they get a choice between a random module for this blueprint, 10 tech points, or 10 research points. Unlike variant research, system/module research is always 100% successful.

The exception is the CV3000's B4 module, which is an exclusive reward to paying players and apparently unobtainable through research.

candidates.text:
The Doomsday Event was a special Galaxy Life event that started on Wednesday December 12th of 2012, and lasted for 14 days, until Wednesday December 25th of 2012. It consists of a determined number of attack waves, that the player must repel to obtain "The Magic Doll" from the Mayan Golems. Rewards are given after a certain number of units are fought, or after a certain amount of time.

After an attack has ended, a 9-hour countdown will start before the next wave is ready to attack. The countdown can be end up instantly by paying chip 18.

The reward for destroying enough golems and completing the event:

50 Thunder Golems

40 Tornado Golems

30 Forest Golems (Doomsday 2022)

25 Earth Golems

20 Fire Golems

candidates.text:
Hello, Commanders!

A fresh Skirmish event has gone live and is ready for action. Available until July 26 at 18:00 UTC, this limited-time event introduces a new ruleset and a different kind of battlefield test for all who take part.

Here's the full report.

Skirmish is a special game mode, accessible directly from the main screen, where each event comes with its own unique ruleset. With no two Skirmishes playing out quite the same way, every event offers a new tactical twist.

For this weekend's Skirmish, the rules are as follows:

- Choose your own deck to battle with.
- You can use a deck with more than 12 Ally cards.
- Draw an extra card each turn.
- Players gain 2 extra kredit slots each turn.

And with the Duel Festival underway, the stakes are sweeter than usual: your first win earns a free random Officer Pack instead of the standard reward - yours only during the festival.

You can access the Skirmish event from either the game’s main screen or the Play menu, where you’ll find a full overview of the mode, its rules, and the reward.

This Skirmish is available from Friday, July 24 at 12:00 UTC until Sunday, July 26 at 18:00 UTC. Assemble your forces, join the fight, and secure your victory - along with the spoils.

See you on the battlefield this weekend!

candidates.title: A New Skirmish Event is Live
candidates.text:
A new Skirmish event is live now until March 10th!

Here’s everything you need to know.

Skirmish is a special game mode, easily accessible from the main screen, where you play with a different set of rules. These rules vary between the Skirmishes - you’ll face something different at every new Skirmish event.

Get ready for thrilling matches with these Skirmish rules:

- Choose your own deck to battle with.
- Skip drawing a card at the start of turn.
- When you destroy an enemy unit during your turn, draw a card.
- Players start with an extra kredit slot.
- At the start of your turn, choose M18 HELLCAT, PANZER III-H or KV-1 1941 to add to your hand and set its cost to 2.

In addition to the exciting and unique battle experience you’ll get with this Skirmish ruleset, you’ll also get a free 1-day Medkit as your first win reward in this Skirmish!

Access your Medkits on your National Progress line, by clicking your player name in the top bar, selecting the “Rewards” tab, and clicking the “Medkit” button on the top-right of the National Progress interface.

Access the Skirmish event from the game's main screen or from the battle screen to get a detailed overview of the game mode, rules and prize.

This Skirmish is available from Friday, March 8th (12:00 GMT) until Sunday, March 10th at 18:00 GMT. Join this special event and win your Skirmish to claim victory and the spoils!

Please let us know what you think of the event in the comments below or on the KARDS Discord.

candidates.text: it took almost 2 hours to load, 1 hour first, about 20 minutes of playtime and then another hour of loading, so it is broken. for the 20 minutes it functioned it felt like a free mobile game. I could not. I was expecting something like “Minecraft but you can build vehicles” or “Subnatuica but you can make your ships and subs” instead I got “click ‘make motorbike’ button to have a motorbike and a walking simulator”. The graphics felt like it was 2010 and I was playing a less square Minecraft knockoff. If you dig the ground out from under something it does not fall, it stays there, floating. the same thing happens with water, it never moves. Back to the tutorial, it just suddenly stopped and it never fully explained things, it would say things like “make a fuel tank” and when I did that it would not respond and I had to figure out that they meant a different fuel tank than the one I made of the 4 options of fuel tank they gave me. candidates.title: How will Fishing work in Update 1.4?
candidates.text:
Greetings Viceroys,

In today’s new entry in the series of Update 1.4 sneak peeks, we present the new building - Fishing Hut - and how the fishing system works.

If you missed the previous ones, you can check them out here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1336490/view/4359006361100133508
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1336490/view/6680607622689846294

Fishing is part of the free Update 1.4 which will accompany the upcoming DLC. The DLC’s new species, new biome, and its release date will be revealed near the end of this month.

Fishing

Fishing is a new way of acquiring resources from ponds found in glades. Similarly to regular resource nodes, there are two sizes of ponds: small (2x2) and large (3x3).

https://youtu.be/FdU5MJkyaU4

There are also different types of Ponds:

- Algae Pond - A murky pond covered with algae bloom.

- A small Algae Pond gives 1 Algae and has a 40% chance for Herbs.
- A large Algae Pond gives 2 Algae, has a 50% chance for Herbs, and a 20% chance for Fish.

- Thunderfish Pond - A very common species of eel.

- A small Thunderfish Pond gives 1 Fish and has a 40% chance for Scales.
- A large Thunderfish Pond gives 2 Fish and has a 50% chance for Scales.

- Copperfin Trout Pond - Caught primarily for its durable scales and fish leather.

- A small Copperfin Trout Pond gives 1 Scale and has a 40% chance for Sea Marrow.
- A large Copperfin Trout Pond gives 2 Scales, has a 50% chance for Sea Marrow, and a 30% chance for Fish.

To fish, players need a Fishing Hut.

candidates.title: Update 1.4 Sneak Peek & DLC Closed Alpha Testing
candidates.text:
Greetings Viceroys!

In today's news, we're going to shed some light on the next free update (which will introduce a highly requested system) and provide some details on how to sign up for the closed alpha testing of the upcoming DLC. So sit back, light some incense, and enjoy the read.

What’s coming in Update 1.4?

Against the Storm's next major update is in the works and will accompany its first DLC release. In order to integrate the new species and biome from the DLC into the game, we need to shake up the game's economy and introduce a variety of changes and new content.

Therefore, Update 1.4 (free for everyone) will introduce:

- New resources
- New buildings
- An increased level cap
- New needs
- New orders
- FISHING!
- And many more

That’s right, fishing and lakes - two highly upvoted feature requests - are coming to Against the Storm. Fishing is a new way to gather resources from ponds (let's call them "small lakes") found in glades. To fish, players need Fishing Huts, which work much like camps, but with a unique spin. Ponds provide new resources that will be introduced in new and existing recipes: fish, algae, and scales.

Small Pond (placeholder model, work in progress)

The DLC and the new update are in the works, but their release is still several weeks away. As this will be our longest break between updates, we'll be sharing more previews over the coming weeks to keep you updated on upcoming changes. Follow us to stay updated!

It takes this long because the DLC and Update 1.4 will be Against the Storm's largest content drop ever. Incorporating the new species and biome into the game without breaking the core requires careful balancing.

Which brings us to our next topic...

DLC Closed Alpha Testing

candidates.text:
Greetings, Viceroys!

It's the day after the Update, also known as "the hotfix day". Despite our best efforts, some issues slipped our attention. Thanks to your swift and precise reports, we were able to identify and deal with them.

Changelog

- Rebalanced the Fish Scraps perk - it now gives +1 to Ground Bait for every 10 Scales/Fish used in crafting.
- Fixed a crash that could occur when adding an automated hauling cart to an unbuilt warehouse in Ashen Thicket.
- Fixed a bug where the "recent" graph in the Trends window would not react to player input.
- Fixed a rare bug where newcomers wouldn't stop coming and they wouldn't stop coming and they wouldn't stop coming.
- Fixed a bug where some Cornerstone Forge effects (such as Gathering Speed or Planting/Harvesting Speed) were not being tracked correctly in the Cornerstone tooltip.
- Fixed a bug where discovering glades would sometimes not count towards an Experimental Cornerstone condition.
- Fixed a bug where the "Feeling Extremely Lucky" deed didn't disappear from the "Tracked" list after being changed in update 1.5.
- Fixed a bug where the "result" text in the Cornerstone Forge was not translated.
- Fixed a bug where the Fish Scraps perk was spawning an empty effect on the HUD when triggering.
- Fixed a few typos in the Polish version of the game (Fish Scraps tooltip, Lori dialogue).
- Fixed a bug with some species effects having different UI frames.

The current game version is 1.5.4.

Thank you once again for your feedback. We wish you a fantastic time with the game and the new update!

May the storm be gentle on you,
Eremite Games

candidates.title: Fishing Update (1.4) Changelog - Part 1 (New features, balance)
candidates.text:
Changes marked with ⚡ were inspired by the community.
Changes marked with 🐸 are related to the Against the Storm: Keepers of the Stone DLC.

New content and features

- ⚡ Added fishing.

- Fishing is a new way of acquiring resources from ponds found in glades.
- To fish, players need a Fishing Hut.
- Fishing Huts work very similarly to camps. There are two types: small and regular. The small one is an essential building, and the regular one needs to be acquired separately (as a blueprint choice, from a trader, or via a wildcard).
- Fishing Huts collect resources from ponds. Similarly to regular resource nodes, there are two sizes of ponds: small (2x2) and large (3x3).
- There are 3 types of ponds:

- Algae Pond - A murky pond covered with algae bloom.

- A small Algae Pond gives 1 Algae and has a 40% chance for Herbs.
- A large Algae Pond gives 2 Algae, has a 50% chance for Herbs, and a 20% chance for Fish.

- Thunderfish Pond - A very common species of eel.

- A small Thunderfish Pond gives 1 Fish and has a 40% chance for Scales.
- A large Thunderfish Pond gives 2 Fish and has a 50% chance for Scales.

- Copperfin Trout Pond - Caught primarily for its durable scales and fish leather.

- A small Copperfin Trout Pond gives 1 Scale and has a 40% chance for Sea Marrow.
- A large Copperfin Trout Pond gives 2 Scales, has a 50% chance for Sea Marrow, and a 30% chance for Fish.

The wait is finally over! Sturdy-as-stone Frogs join Against the Storm as the 6th playable species, while the new biome - Coastal Grove - opens its port to Viceroys searching for sunken treasures.

As the struggle for survival against the Blightstorm continues, Against the Storm - Keepers of the Stone introduces a new species, a new biome, and a selection of new buildings, orders, risks, and opportunities for any Viceroy up for the challenge.

- Added a new species - Frogs.

- Frogs are dignified and proud people with a unique affinity for wealth, renowned for their exceptional skills in architecture and their love of water. They seem to be the least bothered by rain and prefer not to live in ordinary shelters. Frogs are skilled masons and love working with rainwater.

candidates.title: Yet another sneak peek of Update 1.4
candidates.text:
Greetings, Viceroys!
It's been a while since we announced that the upcoming DLC will be accompanied by a massive Update 1.4. The update will be free for everyone and will include, among other things:

- New system: fishing
- New resources
- New buildings
- An increased level cap (20)
- New needs
- New orders
- And many more

If you missed the announcement, you can check it out here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1336490/view/6680607622689846294

Today we want to share even more previews with you!

Before we dive in, we know you've been wondering when the update will arrive. While we don't have a specific date for you just yet, we'll be sharing some time frames later in this post.

Update 1.4 preview

Let's start with some building makeovers. A couple of familiar buildings will get a new look, some inspired by the new species architecture. Here's Press:

As you can see, there are a number of changes coming to the roster of recipes and their ingredients. In Press, you will be able to produce Paste, which is one of the new goods and needs.

With the announcement of new buildings, some of you were rightly worried about the increasing number of blueprints you can roll. We're aware that blueprint bloat can be detrimental to the game, so we've included several systems to reduce it, including locking certain buildings behind species. There are several buildings in the game that won't be offered to you from the Reputation Bonus if you don't have a species in your settlement that would benefit from them the most.

candidates.text:
- First Dawn Company Headquarters Level 13 - new upgrade. Gives Fishing Hut Embarkation Bonus and +1% chance for bonus yields. Purchasable at level 20. - These changes will also affect the Queen’s Hand Trial mode, as the drafted upgrades will be taken directly from the original upgrade tree. Because of this, some of you may see a known issue immediately after the update where one upgrade option in the Citadel has a different tier/price than the others (due to the reshuffling). Subsequent upgrade drafts should all be in the correct order.

- Added new resources to all biomes.

- Royal Woodlands - Scales.
- Scarlet Orchard - Fish, Leather.
- Coral Forest - Scales.
- Marshlands - Algae, Leather.
- Cursed Royal Woodlands - Fish, Leather.
- Sealed Forest - Scales, Algae.

- Slightly adjusted the generation rates of some resource nodes in several biomes (for example: stone/clay and plant fiber/reed nodes now have a slightly higher chance of spawning in the Marshland to compensate for the bigger pool of possible resources).
- Changed the stone deposit in the Marshlands. It's now an "Overgrown Stone Deposit" which has a 30% chance for Algae as a secondary resource (as opposed to Roots from a regular stone deposit).
- Rebalanced geyser generation.

candidates.title: Keepers of the Stone DLC and Fishing Update (1.4) now available!
candidates.text:
In deciding which 3 or 4 recipes should be available in the Field Kitchen (if any should, to be honest), we’ve redefined the role of this building and its T0 recipes. In our opinion, Field Kitchen should lower the risk of taking buildings with recipes for semi-finished goods, used to make Complex Food. It should not be a small factory for Jerky and Porridge, but a building that rewards players for taking risks - for making flour, containers, or dye early on.

These are just some of the bigger changes coming in update 1.4. There are also the aforementioned new goods (scales, fish, algae, boots, paste), new nodes (fish ponds, leather), the reshuffling of resources in the biomes, which we already touched upon, and some significant specialization changes - such as the Foxes losing their Rainwater specialization and gaining a comfort bonus when working in buildings infected with Blightrot.

This specialization change for Foxes is something we wanted to try for a long time, but never really had the time to implement. It fits the flavor of the species, as lore-wise Foxes live in a symbiotic relationship with Blightrot, but it also adds a new gameplay dimension. It’s technically a nerf, but it also reinforces the corruption-heavy playstyle we've been trying to achieve over the last few updates, and it creates potential synergies with other species/perks.

All balance changes in this note and the changelog will be in version 1.4, whether you own the Keepers of the Stone DLC or not. Against the Storm is highly interconnected, so having separate versions isn't practical. We've worked hard to ensure that the experience is as good or better than in version 1.3, whether or not you have the DLC. Many changes weren't just to add new content but also to improve the game's overall pacing and polish.

candidates.title: Here comes the Modest Update!
candidates.text:
The 1.0 update will include the Queen’s Hand Trial - a new mode designed for the most experienced of Viceroys. You can learn more about it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1336490/view/6187444621034882563

DEVELOPER NOTES

As you already know from the intro to this article, Against the Storm is leaving Early Access on December 8th, 2023! So because of this, today’s update is a very special one - it’s the last biweekly Early Access patch before the 1.0 update. So what can you expect?

First of all, "the last biweekly update" does not mean it is the final patch in the game’s history. We will still continue to support Against the Storm and bring you meaningful updates after December 8th! However, it does mean that the update cadence will slow down a bit. The 1.0 launch is a good time to slow things down and let players enjoy the full Against the Storm experience without drastic changes every two weeks. It is also a good time for the team to take a breather, evaluate the game from afar, gather feedback from all the new players, and plan the next move.

We will share more of our post-1.0 plans and hopes in the future, so stay tuned! And for now, let’s move on to the details of today’s update.

With the aptly titled "Modest Update," we bring you a lot of balance changes (mostly to Seals and events), some much-anticipated UI tweaks (mouse keybindings!), and some new content in the form of new achievements and conversations with Aunt Lori.

question: What changes were made to the Coronation system in Crusader Kings III?

candidates.title: Dev Diary #178 - A Vision in Gold
candidates.text:
Coronations are a new Activity type available to Kings and Emperors. They are accompanied by a new Realm Law, which states whether your ruler is Crowned or Uncrowned. While Uncrowned, you suffer Opinion and Legitimacy maluses; the only way to become Crowned is to host a Coronation. Both the Activity and the new laws are DLC-only content, and will not affect players who don’t own this event pack.

[img src=" soon you will be crowned and these modifiers will be history…]

You may only host a Coronation when first becoming a King or Emperor: thus, a Coronation host must either be a new heir succeeding to the throne, or a ruler who has just increased their title tier. The majority of CK sovereigns will only ever hold one Coronation, but this DLC strongly incentivizes everyone king-tier and above to host a Coronation.

The Coronation Activity brings together courtiers, vassals and neighboring rulers to witness the creation of a new sovereign, to socialize, and to politic frenetically in the shadows. Equipped with an array of Intents for hosts and attending characters, and with a wide range of events, Coronation is a relatively reliable source of Legitimacy, Opinion and Prestige (for the host), but can be employed towards many other ends as well.

[img src=" thank you, pointy hat man]

Mechanically, the Coronation Activity focuses on replayability, on reactivity to your current situation, and on agency for both the attendees and host. Through time and across space, coronation ceremonies tended to hit many of the same beats, to use many of the same ideas and phrases, but the context of their words were ever-changing, and we designed with that mutability in mind. These moments were never merely ceremonial. They were always also political.

candidates.text: Crusader Kings III is a marvelous successor to Crusader Kings II. Even without any DLCs, the base game is intriguing, thought provoking, and ingenious in many areas. candidates.text: - Conquest & Invasion CBs now have a dynamic cost scaling with realm size, this should make the CB's cheaper for smaller realms and more expensive for very large ones. - Chthonic Redoubts are no longer impossible to convert in Mountains (-75% instead of -100%). - De Jure CBs are now available one era earlier than before. - Forming the HRE is now possible using any core Carolingian kingdom, not just East Francia, and the De Jure can now include the Empire of Francia if West Francia or enough Francian kingdoms are part of the realm of the one forming the HRE. - Rebalanced the Piety & Prestige costs for Conquests and Invasions to make them more accessible for smaller realms. - Reduced prestige gain from Amenities and exceeding your Grandeur level. - Reduced prestige gain from the Marauder Accolade. - Removed all sources of prestige % gain bonus from innovations to reduce inflation (total 20%). - Significantly reduced Prestige gain from Artifacts (monthly gains, prestige per dread/knight, etc). - Slightly reduced prestige % bonuses from Diplomacy lifestyle perks. - Slightly reduced prestige from the Bodyguard position. - Switched some innovations around for Arabic Heritage cultures so that the Caliph can revoke titles on game start. - The AI should now have a much easier time forming the HRE from an 867 start. - The AI no longer pays Prestige to revoke Court Positions, as they would never abuse court positions in the first place - and the prestige loss would cause them to fairly often be unable to declare wars. - The Mongols now get better Siege Engineer characters. - The Mongols now have a bonus to cavalry damage and toughness, to offset their lack of Stationing Bonuses. - The Mongols now spawn with trebuchets instead of mangonels.

question: How do you create and register a Siege Battle Attack Deck Preset in Summoners War?

candidates.title: [Info] New Feature: Deck Preset
candidates.text:
Q. You mentioned that Presets allow engraving the same Runes or Artifacts on multiple Monsters in different decks. Can I engrave the same Runes or Artifacts on different Monsters within the same deck?

A. No, you cannot engrave the same Runes or Artifacts on different Monsters within the same deck. It is best to think of it as Runes and Artifacts being available for use on a per-Preset basis.

Q. Is there a cost for saving or using Presets?

A. There is no Mana Stone cost for saving or using Presets. Just as there were no swap costs in the existing Siege Battle Rune/Artifact separation feature, you can save and use attack/defense deck Presets without any Mana Stone consumption. This applies to Presets across all content, not just Siege Battle.

==============================​===​

This concludes our introduction to Deck Presets.

We hope this update significantly enhances the convenience of utilizing Runes and Artifacts, allowing you to enjoy each piece of content more strategically.

(The details shared in this Developer's Note are intended to provide a preview and help your understanding.

Since development and testing are still ongoing, there may be some differences in the actual update. We ask for your kind understanding.)

We will continue to listen to your valuable feedback and do our best to make Summoners War even more enjoyable.

Thank you once again to all the Summoners who always support Summoners War.

We will be back with more exciting news in the next Developer's Note.​

candidates.title: [Info] New Feature: Deck Preset
candidates.text:
​Greetings from the Summoners War Dev Team!

How are you all enjoying the 12th Anniversary Festival?

Today, we have prepared an additional Developer's Note to provide more specific details regarding the Deck Preset feature mentioned in our previous note.

Although we have introduced the feature, we understand that some may still find the system a bit complex.

Therefore, we would like to explain it in more detail using the Siege Battle Attack Deck Preset as an example. Please follow along as we explain how to utilize Presets in Siege Battle Attack Decks with the images we have prepared.

Siege Battle Deck Preset

■ Registering the First Siege Battle Attack Deck Preset

Just as you would with the existing Load Deck feature, you can load a saved Preset deck from the battle preparation screen.

You can also move to the attack deck settings screen via the \[Edit Deck] button.

Step 1. Enter the Preset menu from the battle preparation screen.

[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/1_1776674607.%EC%A0%84%ED%88%AC%EC%A4%80%EB%B9%841_%EC%98%81%EB%AC%B8_1776674607.png"]

[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/2_1776674617.%EB%8D%B1%EC%B6%94%EA%B0%80_%EC%98%81%EB%AC%B8_1776674617.png"]

Since no decks have been registered yet, the pop-up is empty. From here, press the \[Add] button to move to the next step.

Step 2. Select Monsters to place in the Preset.

When you press the \[Add] button, the following screen will be displayed. For our first attack deck, we'll set \[Galleon, Poseidon, and Tiana].

candidates.title: [Info] New Feature: Deck Preset
candidates.text:
[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/5_1776674659.%EC%A0%84%ED%88%AC%EC%A4%80%EB%B9%842_%EC%98%81%EB%AC%B8_1776674659.png"]

You can see the first Preset we just created. Let's set up the second Preset in a similar way.

Step 2. Configure the second Attack Deck.

[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/6_1776674670.%EB%AA%AC%EC%8A%A4%ED%84%B0%EC%84%B8%ED%8C%852_%EC%98%81%EB%AC%B8_1776674670.png"]

For the second attack deck, we'll save \[Gin, Teon, and Lushen].

Let's set up the Runes for \[Teon].

As mentioned in the previous Developer's Note, Presets save Rune/Artifact info separately. This means you can assign the same Runes or Artifacts to Monsters stored in different Preset decks.

Therefore, Runes No. 1, 3, and 5 previously engraved on Tiana can be engraved on \[Teon] as well.

​[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/7_1776676126.%EB%A3%AC%EC%84%B8%ED%8C%852_%EC%98%81%EB%AC%B8(%EC%88%98%EC%A0%95)_1776676126.png"]

candidates.title: [Info] New Feature: Deck Preset
candidates.text:
[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/2EN_1776332830.png"]

Now, the second Preset is fully configured.

By saving various attack decks as Presets in this manner, you can engrave the same Runes and Artifacts on multiple Monsters simultaneously for use in Siege Battle.

This eliminates the hassle of repeatedly equipping and unequipping the same Runes/Artifacts. Beyond that, you'll be able to manage your attack deck Runes and Artifacts with ease, even without the Siege Battle Rune separation feature.

(Defense decks will also follow a similar flow.)

Finally, we have organized some points you might be curious about in a Q&A format.

==============================​===​

Q. Once Presets are updated and Siege Battle Rune separation is removed, do I have to set up all my attack and defense decks from scratch?

A. Along with the update, the existing Monster and Rune/Artifact settings for your Siege Battle attack and defense decks will be automatically registered as Siege Battle attack and defense deck Presets, respectively.

Q. After Siege Battle Rune separation is removed, what happens to the Siege Battle Rune/Artifact settings for Monsters not registered in an attack or defense deck?

A. Following the removal of the Siege Battle Rune separation feature, the Rune/Artifact engraving info for all Monsters will revert to their default settings. If you wish to save the Siege Battle Rune/Artifact info for Monsters not currently in an attack or defense deck, we recommend using the \[Siege Battle > Monster > Rune Manage > Settings > Save Runes/Artifacts of all Monsters] feature to save them before the update.

candidates.title: [Info] 12th Anniversary Update Developer's Note
candidates.text:
Lastly, we'd like to wrap up this Developer's Note by sharing a preview of additional content for the 12th Anniversary Update, which we are aiming to release in late April.

■ Late April Update: Deck Preset Feature

We are working on a Preset feature designed to help you navigate and enjoy Summoners War's various content with greater ease.

Here is a brief look at the main aspects of the Deck Preset feature we are working on.

- What is a Preset?

: This is an advanced version of the existing Save Deck feature. A Preset saves not only the Monster info but also the Rune and Artifact info engraved on those Monsters.

: Since information is saved separately for each deck, you can set the same Runes and Artifacts on Monsters saved in different Preset decks.

: For Rune and Artifact info saved in a Preset, you can still use a Monster with the saved Preset info even if you have changed the Monster's default Runes and Artifacts.

- The existing Save Deck feature will be changed to Preset.

: Along with this change, Presets will be additionally provided for Temple of Chaos / Cairos Dungeon / Rift Beast / Dimension Hole (Ancient Guardian) / Monster Subjugation.

- Defense decks of all content will be manageable via Preset.

: Just like in World Guild Battle, Presets will be provided for defense decks in Arena, Arena Interserver Battle, and Siege Battle, allowing Monster and Rune/Artifact info to be saved separately.

- A building will be added where you can manage attack and defense deck Presets in one place.

: As the number of saveable decks increases and unique settings for each deck become possible, a building will be added where you can view and set all attack and defense decks together.

- Siege Battle Rune separation will be removed.

candidates.title: [Info] v8.3.9 Update Developer's Note
candidates.text:
Here, you can see a new [Battle Research] button added to the Guild Tower menu.
When you tap this button, you will see the following screen.

The screen displays defense decks with strategy details and comments on how to improve the decks.
This was prepared to allow Summoners to freely share their thoughts, effective tactics, and areas for improvement when trying out the defense decks.

Now, let's go over the extensive menus and demonstrate how to use the feature.

▶ Register Defense Decks
Tap the [Battle Research] menu to see the following pop-up.

You will see an empty pop-up for now since there are no defense decks registered. Now, let's tap the Register Defense Deck button.

▶ STEP 1. Place Monsters in the defense placement screen.
Tap the [Guild Battle Research > Register Defense Deck] to see the following defense placement screen.

As mentioned earlier, you can also place Monsters you don't own.
Tap the button displayed on the screen to see the Monster selection screen and add Monsters.

The added Monsters will be 6-starred Monsters with MAX level and MAX skill levels.

Once the Monsters are placed, the [Rune/Artifact Settings] button will be activated in the [Defense Placement] screen.

▶ STEP 2. Set up Runes and Artifacts of the placed Monsters.

You can set up three Monsters in a defense deck at once, and the Monsters will have their current Runes and Artifacts engraved initially.
You can also load Runes/Artifacts engraved on other Monsters.
Once you've completed all of the settings, you'll return to the defense placement screen and register the defense deck.

▶ STEP 3. Register the defense deck.

Tap the [Register] button, and you will see a screen asking you to enter the title of the defense deck. Enter the title and the defense deck will be registered.

Here shows the registered defense deck.

In summary, you will go through three steps to register a defense deck.

candidates.title: Patch 1.13 Released!
candidates.text:
Patch 1.13 Released!

Gen’l,

Patch 1.13 is a major update to Grand Tactician (base game) and Whiskey & Lemons DLC. It contains many fixes and rebalancing to the game, and a new Camp-feature for the career mode.

Main changes in the main game include changes in campaign AI, rebalanced construction costs (forts, depots), updates to supply calculations during battles (end of day), along with fixes to bugs reported by the community. The patch was released in beta some time ago and with the help of the community we have improved it further - Thank You for Your help!

The two main updates in Whiskey & Lemons career mode are:

- Camp: as the commander you can choose how to spend your time when encamped. You can focus on a number of activities, from supervising and taking part in drilling your troops to advancing your own personal agenda. Your companions will provide a helping hand as well. This feature is described in more detail in the updated W&L Manual.
- Offer of Command: Earlier you could advance to higher command positions only by using your perstige. Now, if you are eligible and a position where your skills could be used becomes available, you are sometimes offered the new command free of prestige cost. You may then accept or decline the position.

Cheers, and Happy Holidays!

See the patch notes here:
PATCH NOTES

candidates.title: Whiskey & Lemons
candidates.text:
Gen’l,

There were many legendary generals in the American Civil War, like “Stonewall” Jackson, “Old Pete” Longstreet, “Grumble” Jones, “Bull Head” Sumner… each with their own unique stories. In the Grand Tactician DLC, it’s your story.

The Way to the Top – or Not.

Whiskey & Lemons will introduce a new career mode. You will start by creating your character, determining your Civil War personality via a questionnaire, and taking command of a regiment.

As a regimental commander, you are but a small gear in the huge military steam engine. You will have very limited influence over the war, and you will receive orders from your AI commanders. According to your actions and performance, you will generate prestige and get promoted to higher places, where your actions will matter more.

As the DLC campaign will be regiment level, on a zoomed in campaign map, divisions will be the smallest units moving on the campaign map. Single brigades can also be used as garrisons to protect important terrain.

Once commanding a division, you will be able to control the unit on the campaign map. With increased prestige you will be able to influence politics or projects, but this is very limited before rising to the top, commanding the armies of the Union or the Confederacy – provided that you will ever make it that far. Or want to – you can play the whole campaign without accepting any promotions, if you so wish.

Your Story.

There are many things that can get in the way. Your previously mentioned personality could be one of them. Personality is determined on six axes: Loyalty, Piety, Social Life, Heroism, Stress Control and Political Views. These may provide positive and/or negative traits to your career.

candidates.title: Quiet before the Storm?
candidates.text:
"While the citizens have been anxiously waiting for news, it seems like there's a suspicious calm at the frontlines. The reporters of Grand Herald say, it's because the generals of the recently formed Grand Engineering Corps are developing plans and testing them in preparation for the advance."

It's June, and Whiskey & Lemons DLC has enetered internal beta. During this phase we will test, balance and finalize the DLC game play, while all the new playable content is already in. While testing, there's still work going on with giving finalizing touches to remaining art, like maps and music. While we were aiming for a Q2, 2023 release, it's fair to say, that "Summer 2023" is more accurate at this point. Of course we will give more information, when further details are available. With the DLC, we will also release the latest patch to Grand Tactician: The Civil War (1861-1865), which includes fixes and improvements to the base game.

The DLC will bring an all-new Career-mode, where player will start the campaign commanding a single unit. With success and promotions, player can climb to more important positions with more influence in the course of the war. While following AI commanders' orders, players can manage their unit(s), staff, and personal activities.

The Career-mode brings many role-playing elements to the game, allowing a different kind focus in the game, without the need to manage the whole war.

The Career-mode can be used in all the campaign scenarios. In addition, a new Regiment-scale focus campaign can be played in the Eastern Theater. This campaign starts in June 1861, before the start of the large scale fighting. Will the war drag on for years, or will the blue troops march irresistably On to Richmond?

candidates.title: Whiskey & Lemons
candidates.text:
You may also attract companions that will be part of your staff. For example, if you are known for lack of loyalty, you may be followed by a Committee Investigator, reporting to the military brass, who may end up limiting your freedom of action by giving political guidance you cannot ignore.

There are also other new features. You will be able to choose to buy your own equipment, recruit your own staff and carry out actions that all will influence your, and your nation’s Civil War journey. You may also get injured in combat, with some of your injuries becoming permanent disabilities.

When you start to gain fame, you may end up with a grudge with some of your fellow officers. This may have a serious impact on your performance in the battle-field, like what happened between Bragg and his lieutenants. And getting rid of them may prove difficult, as it will require further prestige to overrule choices made by the President.

It will be very different, if you become known as “Old Tippler” due to your drinking habits, keep falling off the horse during battles and get into drunken fights with your fellow officers, or as “Skedaddle Joe” due to lack of courage and losing the respect of your men.

Everything you do and experience during the campaign, will be recorded into a Biography. When the campaign ends, you may read your whole story, and see how you compared with historical civil war commanders.

The Other Things.

We’re looking to release Whiskey & Lemons during Q2 of 2023. The plan and development has suffered some real-life related delays, mainly caused by a war in Europe, where the development team is from.

But, while on some fronts there have been delays, on others extra progress has been made. We’re constantly working on the game engine even if the DLC content has not proceeded as earlier planned.

Who is eligible for FACEIT Platform
Players in regions with an existing Live Service for Overwatch 2 across North America, Latin America, Europe, Middle-East, North-Africa, and Australia-New Zealand are eligible to participate in FACEIT play.

All players of 13 age and older are eligible to use FACEIT.

When can I start playing FACEIT?
Open qualifiers will begin in FACEIT on March 1 2024. In the coming weeks, FACEIT will announce more about their programs, activities and competitions.

How do I use FACEIT?
More details on how to seamlessly play Overwatch 2 through FACEIT will be shared at a later date.

Will my Overwatch 2 experience be different on FACEIT than Battle.Net?
No – playing Overwatch 2 on FACEIT or Battle.Net will be a seamless experience regardless of platform.

Q: Why am I getting a blank screen, restarts, glitches, or strange behavior on mobile?

A: These issues usually come from limited device memory or browser overload. Try this quick fix sequence:

Close all other apps and browser tabs to free RAM.

Clear your browser cache (Settings > Privacy > Clear browsing data → focus on cached images/files).

Restart the browser and reload loverwatch.gg

incognito/private mode can help avoid extension conflicts.

Most players see these problems disappear after freeing memory. For the smoothest, most reliable experience we designed, a PC or M remains the gold standard.

candidates.text: 而玩法不行本该用游戏内容和包装手段掩盖，但游戏内容相对不足的问题反而放大和暴露了这个问题，这也是我对正式版的最大不满。 游戏一共就21个谜团，约两百个事件，而每一把游戏（约半小时）会经历5个剧本和四五十个事件，随便算一算就知道，这种内容量撑死也就能支撑5-10小时的游戏体验，一旦重复内容开始展现，游戏包裹的都市怪谈外壳一戳即破，内核玩法的粗劣之处立刻暴露，低反馈和重复性再加上叙事包裹手段的粗陋（谜团和事件分支差异太小，不同角色玩法流程差异太小）很容易破坏心流体验。 游戏以成就解锁内容的设计更是雪上加霜，本就不多的内容量还有一些条件限制让你必须刻意完成一些内容才能解锁新的内容，完成50个成就后解锁史学社才能算游戏内容大体解锁完，但这个时间点早就无聊到不想继续玩的恐怕大有人在。 虽然我个人因为要写评测为了公正性逼着自己几乎全解锁以获得完整体验，但这套解锁流程在我看来在内容不足的情况下不合理之处相当多，全部体验完整恐怕相当坐牢。 当然作为垃圾食品，游戏本身肯定有吸引人的部分。 1bit像素漫画风与都市怪谈系恐怖搭配的相当好，就算玩法和叙事包裹拉胯，氛围渲染还是相当到位的。 游戏的短平快的流程节奏也许会让很多轻度玩家更适应（但是一想到残念到可以忽略不计的指引这点还是得打问号），mod支持的吸引力也许会一定程度解决内容不足的问题。

candidates.title: Mysteries
candidates.text:
Mysteries can be informally divided into two different categories: free-roam and location-locked.

Free-Roam mysteries do not impede your in-game movement in any way. You can investigate required locations, or go visit the Doctor's Office or Monument, shop for items at Shop in the meanwhile, and so on. An example of Free-Roam mystery is Chilling Chronicle of a Crimson Cape.
Location-locked mysteries have you locked at certain location, disabling access to Shops and other important and invaluable sub-locations. These Mysteries do not have Sidequests. An example of Location-Locked mystery is Vicious Verses of A Violent Vigil.
Some mysteries start as Free-Roam, but become Location-Locked at certain point, usually after 3-4 Investigations. An example of such mystery is Horrible History of Household Hell.

candidates.title: Mysteries
candidates.text:
Mysteries are a gameplay mechanic that tell a story utilizing a series of investigations. The majority of mysteries take place within the city of Shiokawa, and typically investigate anywhere between 4 and 15 locations, usually 8, and sometimes the same location multiple times in a row. In between investigations, the current point in the story will be shown on the upper portion of the screen.

Completing mysteries grants Experience. If the player has not rested at home during the mystery, they will receive [TIRELESS] bonus of +1 Stamina and +1 Reason. Doom will also be lowered by small amount, unless playing at Harbringer of Doom difficulty.

Certain perks and curses also have effects at the end of mysteries, such as Ammo Stash and Holes. New town status is inflicted upon the end of a Mystery.

candidates.title: Guide: Ghost Town
candidates.text:
Unless you are fortunate enough to roll both Hermit AND a Dog/Attack Dog, you will be taking -2 Reason per mystery. Thus, it may help to prioritize decisions that conserve or restore Reason more heavily than usual.
Generally, take opportunites to acquire items and spells. Certain items like Cursed Doll can be very combat-useful, while certain spells like Mind Drain or Ghostly Spear can carry a run.
Don't be afraid to RUN from fights. Also, don't be afraid to REST. Ghost Town's removal of town Shops and other areas means you have more spare DOOM to use.
One Stamina or Reason-based boss mystery out of the five is OK. It may help to save these for last to increase Meat Cleaver's accuracy as much as possible.
Spine-Chilling Story of School Scissors can also give the player a guaranteed weapon (Wooden Bat), though it's mostly worse than Meat Cleaver.
In conclusion, this challenge is very RNG-heavy and frustrating. However, by taking these steps, you can save yourself a lot of gambling and introduce a little more strategy into the run. Good luck!

candidates.title: WORLD OF HORROR review
candidates.text: Have you ever wondered whether you'd survive a horror manga? With this game, you can find out! (And the answer is, "Probably not.")WORLD OF HORROR plays like a text-based roguelike with amazingly artistic 1-bit graphics. You have stats to manage, but the meat of the game is learning what events you're likely to encounter in certain adventures, and figuring out how to make the right choices to deal with them. It's pretty simple at bottom, but there's a TON of content to process.What's more, there's an option for custom adventures if you're so inclined, meaning the game is theoretically unlimited if people are willing to make content for it. The custom files have the clever extension *.ITO, which is a nice touch.I've really enjoyed my time with WORLD OF HORROR. If you enjoy horror manga or interesting horror games, you'll appreciate this game, too.

candidates.title: WORLD OF HORROR review
candidates.text: A game I bought many years ago assuming it would never be fully completed, however this Halloween the full game was released and it a finely polished piece of visual art, a stark and enrapturing visual style clearly inspired by the works of Junji Ito and J-horror of the 2000's but with a simplistic point and click gameplay which rewards experimentation and knowledge more than reflexes and intuition. The writing and quirky horror narratives which fill this game and a mix of funny parodies of its inspirations, Ito as previously mentioned as well as the works of Lovecraft, and full on intriguing horror mysteries which reward hesitation and planning. This is a game I whole-heartedly recommend if you have an interest in horror and puzzle games and people who want to see how much there is too this world the dev has made

candidates.title: WORLD OF HORROR review
candidates.text: I had a good time exploring the mysteries at first-- the art is excellent and the writing is solid enough. It's a good game to dip into for a weekend.There's some parts of the game where I wish more content existed. There's around ten mysteries, which is fine, but they start to repeat rather quickly. This is fine too, as you get to figure out how to handle each mystery, but I wish there were more of the mysteries to dive into. I've won the game maybe 2-3 times, and the runs where I lose are still fairly fun. However, unless you have events memorized, it seems really challenging to keep a good balance of stamina/doom/reason while also using casting spells. I would have liked it if the spells were easier for me to justify using. Rituals are also really tough to justify. It's easier to just run away. I would have liked being able to use rituals without taking a bunch of hits. Each investigation usually comes with a couple of choices-- it's really unclear how those choices are going to affect my character. I wish there was a way to make those sort of decisions better. I really enjoy how a lot of the game comes down to chance. It's unfair, but it doesn't really bug me. I liked the variance between each run. I also like how I get to choose which area to investigate-- being able to go to different locations, different shops, etc. was cool. I like how the game handles tension. Each run is compelling, as you're having to constantly balance doom, reason, and stamina. It makes your choices really important, which is great. Without rote memorization, or a guide, or actively taking notes, you're kinda in a tough place with even knowing what choices your making, though. For a game like this, I didn't really find the extreme randomness of my choices rewarding.

candidates.title: WORLD OF HORROR review
candidates.text: World of Horror (WoH) is a very good game with a pretty bad tutorial and doesn't tell you much else. I've beaten the game a few times so far and definitely think it's for a specific crowd.If you want to get into the game:- Do the spine-chilling story of school scissors and run through the combat tutorial, but its not that great in my opinion so you might honestly want to watch a quick video breaking it down. Make sure to go into your storage and read the notes your friend left behind, although to be honest not sure how helpful they are.- After spine-chilling story of school scissors, do extracurricular activity before going into quick play/custom playthrough. Extracurricular has 4 mysteries instead of the 5 in normal quick play so it'll be alot easier. Notes the game does not tell you about but will help you (especially after reading the negative reviews):- Go home and open the cupboards in your room because there's a chance they will contain empty bottles- Take a bath. You usually always want to take a bath between mysteries, whether for health regen or exp boost. You'll want to fill up the empty bottle you found here too, and you can refill it every time you bathe (once between mysteries)- Go to the closest to change your clothes, but the little toy on the top left has 1 fund. Pretty nice.- Pick mysteries that have you start in the city. I know this may not be such a nice tip but after playing the game enough, you'll know what mysteries lead where. My favorite is the eel mystery since you immediately get a follower, Kana, and getting enough followers to do lots of damage via the follower attack is pretty nice when you don't have good weapon or other stats.- Following the previous tip, go to either the store in downtown or the hardware store by the sea to pick up some starting equipment.

candidates.title: WORLD OF HORROR review
candidates.text: World of Horror is still in development as of writing this and I've played the game on and off as updates have come out. The art, stories, mysteries, it's all so fun and enjoyable. Multiple endings for mysteries is something that adds replay-ability to the game as well. I really like horror games and this is one of the new games that doesn't repeat the same thing as others. Shout out to Puppet Combo too, they make scary games that aren't full of jump scares if you're looking for a scary game. If you like horror, mystery, and manga then this game is for you. Definitely worth buying this game, can't wait to see it finished.

candidates.title: Mysteries
candidates.text:
Sidequests are smaller investigation sequences in mysteries. Sidequests are optional and can be accomplished anytime before the prompt for the final investigation appears.

Completing a Sidequest might allow you to see a different Ending of a Mystery, grant you Items or other bonuses, sometimes they might penalize you for your curiosity; all Sidequests, when complete, will grant you an extra 15 Experience at the end of the Mystery via the [THOROUGH INVESTIGATION] bonus.

Currently, there are 3 different types of Sidequests:

Investgate X twice: You must investigate a certain Location twice. This is the 'default' Sidequest type in World of Horror.
Gather Gossip: You must visit Schoolyard and ask Students within for Gossip. Chilling Chronicle of a Crimson Cape and Nightmare News of the Noisy Nails are the two mysteries that utilize this type of sidequest.
Discard 2 items: You must Discard 2 items from your Inventory. Sorrowful Saga of the Moonlight Sailors and Rotten Report of a Rancid Ramen are the Mysteries with this type of Sidequest. All Items that have 'Discard' button are viable, no matter the source (bought at Shops, Weapons found during Combat, drops from Enemies etc etc).

candidates.title: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector review
candidates.text: Right, this game feels more like a proof of concept demo than a full release. My suggestion is to wait about six months to a year then check back to see if the developer has made any progress.But to go farther into why I feel this game is underdeveloped: First, there are only two playable factions in this game right out of the box. The Blood Angels, and the Tyranids. There is a third faction in "The Sisters of Battle' that is only present as an NPC faction used during the new Planetary Supremacy mode.Only the Blood Angels have a dedicated single player campaign, the Tyranids are playable during multiplayer and planetary supremacy only. The Blood Angels campaign is also very limited. pretty much a linear path of missions which always ends the same way. Then they have the nerve to charge 5 dollars for two elite dlc packs. Each adding a small selection of units to the Blood Angels and Tyranids. Oh, wait, you want a third playable faction? Well, instead of the Battle Sisters already programmed into the game have these necrons which will have an annoyingly broken mechanic which makes them overpowered in multiplayer. And of course they don't get a single player campaign. Multiplayer and Planetary supremacy only.Honestly, if the devs do read this, I am sorry that this comes off as harsh, but I only state this because of how solid the gameplay itself is. This plays and feels like a good adaptation of the current table top Warhammer 40k experience. But I feel like you guys launched this way too early to call it a full release. At least mark it as a pre-release build and assure your customers that the game will have more content added in the near future. Do that and I will change this review to a glowing recommendation. But as a full release, I just can't recommend this to anybody.EDIT: So yeah, quite a bit has changed since I first wrote this.

candidates.title: Dev Diary #5 - Necrons are coming to Battlesector!
candidates.text:
++ Thought of the day ++
Though your service may be bold and unflinching, only in righteous death will the Emperor know your name.

Today we’ve announced a number of new additions coming to Battlesector in 2022. The team at Black Lab Games is really excited to be working on a new faction and a new campaign system.

Since launching Battlesector in July, we’ve seen a lot of requests for more factions. Today, we are pleased to announce the first new faction we’ll be adding to the game. Awakening after 60 million years of slumber, the Necrons are coming to Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector.

Creating a faction for Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector is a significant task. There is a lot of work that goes into creating the highly detailed models and their animations, designing and implementing special abilities, balancing, writing and recording voice-overs, and more.

We are putting the same amount of effort and care into the Necrons as we did for the Blood Angels and Tyranids in the base game. Hopefully, this attention to detail comes through in the images above and below.

The Necron Faction Pack will be a paid DLC. You’ll be able to put Necron armies on the field in skirmish and multiplayer battles... and in a brand new campaign type.

The new campaign type will use an entirely new system. It is a “conquest-style” campaign, in which 3 factions - the Blood Angels, Tyranids and Necrons - battle to eliminate the two other factions from the map.

You’ll capture territory, build your army and battle for control of valuable resources that can turn the tide of war. Each playthrough will be unique and every battle takes place on a procedurally-generated map.
The new campaign type will be a free addition to Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector.

question: When is the new season and Blood Pass launching for Blood Bowl 3?

candidates.title: Blood Bowl 3 | Season System Breakdown
candidates.text:
[/previewyoutube]

1 – Why do seasons last 3 months?

Three months is the right length of time to keep the game exciting and to give players enough time to enjoy the season’s content. We really want each season to have its own identity. This means strong, impactful new content that gives a real sense of a fresh experience.

It’s also important to consider the impact on the competitive environment that fresh or updated content, such as a new Faction or new Star Player, can bring.

2 – The Blood Pass

The Blood Pass will be linked to a season and its content will change every three months as well.
There are two versions of the Blood Pass:

a) The free version of the Blood Pass will allow you to unlock cosmetic rewards during the season for playing matches and the Faction of the Season for free if you complete the Blood Pass.

b) The paid version can be bought at any point during a season, and it allows you to instantly get the Faction of the Season and even more cosmetic rewards.

Note that the Blood Pass is retroactive, which means you can upgrade it at any time during the season and immediately get the rewards you would have unlocked with your playtime.

Also, each tier of the Blood Pass requires the same amount of experience (XP). It does not become more “grindy” as you progress.

3- Warpstone

Warpstone is the in-game currency. You can earn Warpstone by playing the game, as a reward for certain Blood Pass tiers, by leveling up, or by buying it directly.

With Warpstone you can buy cosmetic items in the shop, use it to buy the Blood Pass, and acquire factions from previous seasons.

4 – How do you progress through the Blood Pass tiers?

candidates.title: Blood Pass Season 2
candidates.text:
Hi Coaches,

A new season brings a fresh Blood Pass! This is also the first season where the Blood Pass is available in the shop, as the Season 1 Blood Pass was given for free as compensation. Now feels like a good time to remind you about the different Blood Pass options: Regular and Premium.

Before going into details, we want to remind you that you can unlock the Faction of the Season for free by completing all 50 tiers, while getting the rewards from the Free tiers in the process. Once you unlcok the Faction, it's permanent. You have it for this seasons and the next to come.

Regular Blood Pass - 1000 Warpstone:

Gain access to the complete Blood Pass content with 50 tiers to unlock as you play.

Blood Pass content includes:

1 New Faction: Underworld Denizens
6 Epic Customizations
23 Rare Customizations
6 Common Customizations
1 Pitch
1 Coach
1 Cheerleader
3 Dugouts
1 Ball
2 Dice Sets
250 Warpstone

Premium Blood Pass - 2000 Warpstone:

Unlock the next 20 tiers of the Blood Pass immediately. You receive all the rewards from the 20 unlocked tiers right away and continue your progression from there.

Note that the Blood Pass is retroactive, so if you purchase it when you are already at Tier 30, you will receive all the rewards from the first 30 tiers as well. This ensures that you won't miss out on any rewards regardless of when you acquire your Blood Pass.

The Regular Blood Pass is a good option for players who plan to spend some time enjoying BB3 and want all the cosmetics content in the process.

The Premium Blood Pass is an option for players with limited playtime who want to ensure they don't miss out on any rewards or for those who want to enjoy certain cosmetic rewards immediately.

In both cases, players have access to the same rewards, and in both cases, you unlock the Underworld Denizen faction right away, permanently.

candidates.title: Blood Bowl 3 review
candidates.text: The game is littered with microtransactions. Some teams are locked behind a season pass meaning you have to grind for countless hours before you unlock a new team. And then there is the FOMO aspect of the season pass. Teams can also be bought for the premium currency, warpstones but those are expensive and buying new teams with them is not worth the price tag. All in all the game is terrible, there is no eternal league, only boring ass campaign, rules are BB2020 rather than BB2016 like in Blood Bowl 2 but overall the game is way worse. It would be much better if new teams were a DLC and not some unlockable season pass gimick. If you add more league customization, Eternal League and all teams availible for free or as a DLC (Not behind warpstone paywall) then I will reconsider changing my review to positive.

We hope you understand that changing this system will require time including refunding the players who already spent their Warpstone on items that will be unlimited after the patch. We will come back with an exact date for these changes once we’ve got all the technical confirmations we need.

FIRST SEASON BLOOD PASS FOR ALL

It remains our plan to launch the Season 1 in May 2023. A new Faction will be released and seasonal features like the Official Ladder and the Blood Pass will be implemented.
We appreciate that the launch hasn’t gone as well as it could and with that in mind, we want to start the new season right.

The Season 1 Blood Pass, including the first new faction, will be free to unlock for everyone.

We believe these changes and announcements will contribute to make Blood Bowl 3 a more fair and enjoyable experience for all our players. We know that there is still a lot of work to implement features and fix elements of the game, and we remain committed to that as our main priority.

candidates.title: Fight For Your Life
candidates.text:
Certain characters in Borderlands 3 have special skills that give them extra abilities in Fight For Your Life.
Moze - To the Last allows Moze to throw grenades while in Fight For Your Life, and will refund a grenade should she get a Second Wind after throwing at least one grenade during Fight For Your Life.
Zane - Old-U can be used to sacrifice his Digi-Clone, giving himself a Second Wind with full health.
Amara - Guardian Angel, when not on cooldown, instantly grants Amara a Second Wind upon being crippled. She will recover up to 50% of her health and generate an elemental nova based on the element of their Action Skill.
FL4K - Lick the Wounds allows FL4K's pet to revive them when they go into FIght For Your Life. If the revive is successful, the pet gains a 30% damage buff for 60 seconds. The pet will seek out FL4K, the revive taking priority over fighting any targeted enemy.
If Not My Circus is equipped then it will take priority over the revive, and as such the pet will seek out an enemy and taunt before going to revive FL4K.

candidates.title: Fixes for Beta issues implemented
candidates.text:
Hello everyone,

Here's a quick update of the changes implemented so far this week:

- Game now shows the actual chat key mapping next to the chat icon.
You can change the key mapping in the main menu. It is highly recommended to use Enter, as the chosen key is also used to submit messages in the chat. I.e. if the chosen key for chat was "z", messages in chat must also be submitted using "z".
- Active players will now see alerts before the server will be shut-down for maintenance.
There will be three alerts: 15 minutes, 5 minutes and final alert. The server will shut down immediately after the final warning, so make sure to save any of your progress before then.
- A fix was implemented for (Wacom) tablets not working in the game on Windows computers.
You may have to activate "Windows Ink" for the stylus to work properly in the game.

Thank you for your patience as we continue to work on the issues reported via our ticket system!

candidates.title: Bard
candidates.text:
The Advanced Dungeons and Dragons 2nd Edition ruleset provides the basis for the inspiration, design and practical details for the Baldur's Gate game rules and game implementation.

The Player's Handbook - PHB - has a whole section on the Bard class - see the external links at the bottom of the page for further reading.

For a more in-depth view of the Bard class features, character generation, requirements, abilities and leveling, see the second external link.

In short, the BG video game stayed close to the source material in some aspects of the BG game implementation, and moved further away on others, and invented their own rules/abilities and restrictions in other aspects of the bard class - indeed, some PnP rules for bards are not implemented at all in the BG video game.

candidates.title: Dev Diary #37: The Hero Rework
candidates.text:
And here it is in game, this particular warrior is aiming for a build around an aggressive charge, quickly slaying their opponent with one swift strike before using second wind to recover and reposition!

The warrior, just like the defender, lacked active skills in their first iteration which was addressed here, giving them a bit more flash.

Second wind in particular is worth highlighting, as it is part of the “Streamlining” I have tried to do with hero abilities to address the ability bloat. Second Wind is a mashup of the old Sprint ability and Bloodlust (Barbarian culture), the effect of sprint was lessened a bit to move it out of the territory of the Skirmishers and make it a more versatile tool for warriors, the extra movement and slippery lets the hero lash out at a nearby enemy while the healing effect gain lets them stay in the fight longer.

The attempt to tackle hero ability bloat is more clearly exemplified in the next class, the Mage.

Mage

Expected Role(s): Battlemage
Strengths: Magic damage, Area of effect, Range, afflictions
Weaknesses: No melee, low Defense and Health
Weapons: Orbs, Staves

Final version of the Mage Skill Tree

Mage came third, and is a much more “specific” concept, spellcasting as a unit role existed before the hero rework, but they were one-off abilities that scale poorly as the game progressed. I wanted to strengthen the feel of a hero being a “Mage” by giving the unit abilities that they can then modify through their skill choices.

Mage is roughly divided into “Devastator” and “Warlock”, with the devastator side granting AoE magic abilities and focusing on damage dealing while the warlock side specializes in status effects and control.

candidates.title: Factions (Total War: Three Kingdoms)
candidates.text:
Factions are hierarchical organisations of characters bound by common purpose, and form the discrete power blocks in Total War: THREE KINGDOMS. Each faction is led by a faction leader (also known as a Warlord, and after whom the faction is named), who is supported by their family, ministers, administrators, generals, spies, and any other unassigned characters in player's court. To learn more about court management, see Court.

There are a number of playable factions in Total War: THREE KINGDOMS, each of which has its own famous leader from history, and its own unique playstyle, which is largely defined by its leader's specialisation and its faction specialisation.

There are many more computer-controlled factions in the game, all of whom seek the same ultimate goal as the player: to become the ruling faction of all China, with their faction leader as emperor.WELCOME TO THE TOTAL WAR: THREE KINGDOMS GLOSSARY.

The faction names are the same as that of their starting faction leaders. When the factions advance into higher faction rank, the faction name will change depending on the factional leader, geographic locations, or other cultural tradtions. For example, historically Liu Bei established Kingdom of Shu-Han, player will see the faction name change to it once Liu Bei advance his faction into King level.

candidates.title: Quests
candidates.text:
When selecting a quest, each quest has a name, a short description, the quest's difficulty from one to five stars, the focus, and a set of rewards. Quests can either be combat, negotiation, or combat and negotiation based, though the focus doesn't always dictate what you need to do.

In Sal's campaign, you often choose one quest between three different quest givers. In both campaigns, major characters will also give a quest or a choice between two of them.

While the dialogue and general structure of each individual quest is always the same, the characters involved are often random, or randomly selected from a certain faction or role.

candidates.title: Factions (Total War: Pharaoh)
candidates.text: Factions are the various coherent power blocs in Total War: Pharaoh. Each faction is led by a charismatic leader, with unique bonuses, military specialisations, units and faction mechanics that define the benefits and playstyle of their faction. Aside from the main playable characters who had a major role in the fate of the Bronze Age, there are many more computer-controlled factions in the game, all of whom seek to become the dominant force in the world.

candidates.title: Medieval: Total War
candidates.text:
Medieval: Total War is based upon the building of an empire across medieval Europe, North Africa and the Middle East. It focuses on the warfare, religion and politics of the time to ultimately lead the player in conquest of the known world. As with the preceding Total War game, Shogun: Total War, the game consists of two broad areas of gameplay: a turn-based campaign map that allows the user to move armies across provinces, control agents, diplomacy religion, and other tasks needed to run their faction, and a real-time battlefield, where the player directs the land battles and sieges that occur.

The strategic portion of the game divides the campaign map among twenty factions from the period, with a total of twelve being playable. The initial extent of each major faction's territory, and the factions available, depends on the starting period of the game, Early (1087), High (1205) or Late (1321), reflecting the historical state of these factions over time.

The factions themselves represent many of the major nations at the time, including the Byzantine Empire, the Papacy, France, England, the Holy Roman Empire and the Turkish Sultanate of Rum. Several factions, such as the Golden Horde, emerge during the course of play at their historical time. These factions, together with several other factions appearing at the start of the campaign, are unavailable to the player in the main campaign. Each faction varies in territory, religion and units; however, factions of the same culture share many of their core units.

In addition to the main campaign, Medieval: Total War also features a game mode where the player can undertake various historical campaigns and battles. Historical campaigns allow the player to control a series of famous battles from a war of the medieval period, such as the Hundred Years War and the Crusades, playing as historic commanders like Richard the Lionheart.

candidates.title: Factions
candidates.text:
Once you wash up on the shores of Aeternum you’re guided through a series of beginner quests. You will need to complete those quests to unlock factions. Once you complete the first few quests, you will be directed to the closest town. Continue to progress through these quests and you will eventually meet the leaders of each Faction. The map is colour coded, with the hues approximately matching the development phases in which we expect to deliver each section. Yellow is the zones which will release with the initial UE5 launch, green covers the areas added in the following 9 months, brown is the areas which will be delivered following that, and finally red are the areas which will unlock up to the "final release" (Helios Archipelago is out of bounds on this map but would be red).

Development won't follow the boundaries precisely, as some areas are needed for earlier quests and other areas are for late-game content only, but this gives a rough guide. The two-tone areas are those which will start in one phase of development but will be revisited later on.

Additionally the areas won't just appear all at once, rather once province at a time will be added along with quests, tombs, romance NPCs, and other content.

How Will This Impact the Main Story?
Unlike in UE4, the UE5 build of the game breaks the faction quests into their own questlines. The main story will unfold in a linear fashion as the world expands, with the side factions becoming available as their territory is made playable. The first of these will be the Merchant's Guild, as their "free city" resides in The Bulls Shield.

candidates.title: Factions in Redemption
candidates.text:

Enemy gangs will not be hostile (unless the player attacks them first), so they assisting them and providing ammunition is in the player's best interests.

Some members of these Factions can be encountered as Undead. Undead Lawmen or Undead Gang Members are most encountered in places they were found in Single Player. For example, Undead Walton's Gang will most likely be found in Twin Rocks, Armadillo, and around Cholla Springs. candidates.title: Infinite Lagrange Wiki
candidates.text:
Much of the flow of the game, at least in the beginning, is centered around main missions organized into chapters. The missions in each chapter push the player's faction forward by providing rewards, in the form of resources, and additional rewards for the completion of each chapter.

In Chapter 5 of the missions, one of the missions is to join a Union. While it is possible to join any Union to complete this mission, players - whether Casual or Competitive - should consider joining an active and well-organized Union. These Unions will offer a more engaging experience regardless of playstyle.

In addition to the main missions for each faction, there are also a series of galactic events - missions that all of the factions in the system (server) work together to achieve, many of which require multiple players working together to accomplish, usually as part of an organization.

candidates.text:
Greetings, medievalists!

Did you know there are different factions in the game? Yeah, in our alternative history, where the Black Death destroyed 95% of the population, such world-changing events naturally gave rise to some interesting groups.

You can learn more about them by selecting Historical Records in the top-right corner of the screen and opening the Factions tab.

[img src=" relationship with factions can be Neutral, Friendly, or Hostile. But even Friendly factions may try to bully you with a demand here and there. It’s a dog-eat-dog world out there.

We want to take these relationships a bit further, and that starts with diplomacy.

In the next big update, you’ll be able to initiate diplomacy with a settlement your caravan has traveled to. Once there, you’ll be able to negotiate a deal and decide what you need from that settlement.

This way, your precious settlers can avoid potential death in combat, which is neat. But what is the cost of such a deal? Well… it depends.

The bigger the favor, the bigger the demand. Some factions may ask for resources. Others may want one of their prisoners returned. Some might even send you on a quest to clear out a bandit camp or ambush an enemy faction.

candidates.title: Warhammer 40,000: Warpforge review
candidates.text: I gave it a few days but I get more annoyed w/ each passing day. You would think the main purpose of this game would be to have fun playing a card game w/ your favorite faction, but sadly it is not. The purpose of this game is to complete daily missions because nothing else will make meaningful progress in the game. While that sounds perfectly normal, these dailies are plagued w/ faction specific quests. These will even populate if you don't have a viable deck since they can be completed in bot practice games using free practice decks. So rather than play with your favorite faction, you have to spam bot games w/ factions you don't like that aren't optimized to complete dailies. You can't even try to progress w/ alternate factions and make daily specific decks to speed up these bot games since custom decks cannot be used against bots.Also of note is draft mode. You are limited to 1 free draft per day, get terrible rewards (which I could ignore) but you have to start off by picking your faction from a random choice of 3. So again you are often stuck playing decks you have zero interest in because that is how the game is designed.

candidates.title: Expeditions
candidates.text:
Expeditions are five-player instanced dungeons that will take players to the darkest corners of Aeternum. There, your party will face dire threats, learn more about the source of Corruption, expose the Angry Earth's ulterior motives, reveal the deeper menace behind the Lost, and delve into the secrets of the ancient Guardians. Players can expect challenging battles which require skill and team coordination to complete. Expeditions require a group of three to five players for completion.

Each expedition will tell its own story and be a unique experience. Expedition have loot and gear unique to that experience to incentivize exploring and conquering the various expeditions spread throughout Aeternum. In successive expeditions, the mechanics and puzzles are going to vary. For example, AI sets for bosses and mini-bosses will differ, and loot tables will be unique for each expedition.

Expeditions can also be enhanced/altered with Mutators.
